templates.classic:
Put this moment on your phone case. $79 USD.

MyCase 4.0 is a phone case with an e-paper back.
Pick an image in the app and the case changes right there.

・No power needed to keep the image on (no battery)
・Rewrites in about 25 seconds, without taking the case off
・Fits iPhone 13–17

templates.myth:
"It's an LCD, right?" → E-paper. Looks like printed paper.
"You have to charge it, right?" → No charging. 0W to hold the image, no battery.
"The designs are fixed, right?" → Any image you like. Photos or illustrations.
"It takes forever, right?" → About 25 seconds. From the app, case still on.
"It's expensive, right?" → $79 USD.

MyCase 4.0 might not be what you expected.
